item.title: Japan ST Mark and Korea KC: Selling Toys into Japan and Korea
item.description: Japan and Korea both test toys for the same hazards as the EU and US — but neither accepts an EN71 or CPC report. What the ST Mark and KC confirmation actually require, who can apply, and how to plan the labels.
